visual.general_description: Single composite figure titled "Clinical Parameters Over Time" with eight line-chart subplots in two rows of four (Total IgE, AEC, SCORAD, DLQI; ACQ-5, IgG4 rDer p 1, IgG4 rDer f 1, IgG4 rAlt a 1), each plotting one orange line with markers against weeks (x axis 0 to about 50, label "Weeks", y axis label "Value") with a blue dashed vertical line labelled "Dupilumab start" at week 0 and a red dashed vertical line labelled "AIT start" at about week 8.
visual.detailed_description: Single composite figure titled "Clinical Parameters Over Time" with eight line-chart subplots in two rows of four (Total IgE, AEC, SCORAD, DLQI; ACQ-5, IgG4 rDer p 1, IgG4 rDer f 1, IgG4 rAlt a 1), each plotting one orange line with markers against weeks (x axis 0 to about 50, label "Weeks", y axis label "Value") with a blue dashed vertical line labelled "Dupilumab start" at week 0 and a red dashed vertical line labelled "AIT start" at about week 8. Total IgE (IU/ml) falls from about 8400 to about 450 over four points (weeks 0, about 6, 24, 48). AEC (cells/uL) falls from about 1000 to about 100. SCORAD falls from about 103 to about 1, DLQI from about 30 to about 0, ACQ-5 from about 2.8 to about 0. The three IgG4 subplots (titled rDer p 1, rDer f 1 and rAlt a 1, kE/l) rise from near baseline to about 86, 114 and 107 respectively with markers at weeks 0, about 14, about 30 and 48. Subplots have no patient identifiers or panel letters.

visual.general_description: Composite of six color clinical photographs of a shirtless adult man in a 2-row by 3-column grid: upper row and lower row each show the front of the chest, the back of the shoulders and upper back, and the back of both hands; the face is cropped at about the lower face in the front views.
visual.detailed_description: Upper row (left to right): front of the upper chest and shoulders with the lower face and chin at the top edge against a pale wall, with a few small scattered linear marks on the central chest; the upper back and shoulders seen from behind against a wall with a teal edge at the left; both hands with fingers spread, backs of the hands toward the camera, a ring on one finger of each hand, over a pale surface with the feet visible beneath. The skin in the upper row, particularly the hands and back, looks drier and more textured with scattered faint marks. Lower row: the front of the chest with the nose-to-chin part of the face at the top edge in a different room with a wooden door; the upper back and shoulders from behind; both hands, backs up, a ring on one finger of each hand, on a patterned carpet. The skin in the lower row looks more uniform and smoother than in the upper row. No panel letters, arrows, scale bars or printed text are visible.
